configOptions.name: Effort
configOptions.description: Available effort levels for this model

options.name: architect
options.description: High-level planning and architecture decisions. Use when designing new features, evaluating tradeoffs, or making decisions that affect the whole system.

options.name: code-simplifier:code-simplifier
options.description: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality. Focuses on recently modified code unless instructed otherwise.

options.name: mechanic
options.description: Fast mechanical tasks — search, grep, rename symbols, find TODOs/FIXMEs, generate boilerplate, check file structure. Use for any task that does not require reasoning or judgment.

options.name: reviewer
options.description: Hostile, paranoid code reviewer for the Aspis ecosystem (Cloudflare Workers, CSP-strict static web, React Native/Expo, Python, Scaleway). Use for a critical audit of a diff, file, or feature before merging.

options.name: sonnet-coder
options.description: Primary workhorse for the bulk (~80%) of production coding across the Aspis ecosystem (Cloudflare Workers, CSP-strict web, React Native/Expo, Python, Scaleway). Use for normal feature work, bug fixes, wiring, refactors, and tests. Escalate to veteran-coder ONLY for extreme/critical/architecturally-hard cases.

options.name: veteran-coder
options.description: EXTREME CASES ONLY — the engineer of last resort for the hardest, most critical, most architecturally-dangerous production code across the Aspis ecosystem (Cloudflare Workers, CSP-strict web, React Native/Expo, Python, Scaleway). Subtle concurrency, deep refactors, problems too hard for sonnet-coder. For normal/bulk coding use sonnet-coder instead.
